For a 50-person Indian company, I’d compare the economics this way. The biggest issue is that travel “cost” is mostly fare + supplier penalties + TMC/service fees, not a fixed subscription.

Option	Core fees	Cancellation / changes	Support	Best fit
ITILITE	No platform fee; travel is usage-based. India pricing is quoted after spend tier; no minimum commitment. 
Itilite
+1
	Supplier fare/hotel penalties and fare differences apply. ITILITE says no extra fee for support or modifications within the same trip. 
Itilite
	24/7 human support included; dedicated AM from Growth tier. 
Itilite
	Best balance for a 50-person company
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee + fare/hotel price + GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply to wallet/card payments. 
MakeMyTrip
	Depends heavily on airline/hotel. Selected myBiz fares offer free cancellation/date changes. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
	Primarily platform-led support	Best for India-heavy domestic travel
FCM Travel	Custom TMC quote; no public standard price.	Supplier cancellation/reissue rules apply; cancellation can reach 100% of booking value. Refunds may wait until supplier funds arrive. 
FCM Travel
	24/7 support, travel manager, duty-of-care and emergency assistance. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Best for complex/international travel
OfficeKit HR Platinum	Custom per-user/month quote; Platinum includes travel management. 
OfficeKit HR
	Travel-provider rules apply; don't treat the HRMS subscription as cancellation protection.	HRMS/support model rather than a dedicated TMC	Best if you also need HR/payroll
What I'd ask for in the quote

For 50 employees, get each provider to quote 100 domestic flight bookings + 50 hotel nights + 20 cancellations/changes. That exposes the real TCO much better than the headline subscription.

Also specifically request: booking fee, reissue fee, cancellation fee, GST/ITC handling, unused-ticket credits, 24/7 support SLA, implementation fee, and any annual minimum spend.
